evals.prompt: Here is a paste for Harbour Balanced Advantage Fund Growth. NAV 48.26 as of 2026-09-12, TER 1.61%, AUM 22310 Cr, 3Y 12.5%, 5Y 12.8%. Make this a client PDF.
evals.expected_output: Asks for remaining briefing slots (tone, sections, PDF-only confirmation, dump-as-canonical) before generating. Does not invent extra returns. Does not paint metric tiles in mint/mustard/peach.

evals.prompt: Make a deck for the top hybrid funds. Use the Growthvine connector. I also want a 'why this category' page we have not designed before.
evals.expected_output: Asks tone and length. Resolves plans. Uses get_category_leaderboard or get_category_funds, not a 1Y sort. Invents 'why this category' from lede + category stats, not a new palette.

evals.prompt: Turn this attached AMC factsheet dump into slides, sales tone, include SIP illustration and FAQs.
evals.expected_output: Treats dump as canonical. Sales tone with one CTA. SIP chapter uses oversized stat + labeled assumptions or asks for missing SIP inputs instead of inventing 12%.

evals.prompt: Make a client PDF of the C split mock look. Cover fingerprint is overlapping the stairs in my last export. Put the Growthvine logo on it.
evals.expected_output: Asks remaining briefing slots if missing. Cover uses a two-column mint board: copy/stairs left, fingerprint clipped to an arcs-slot on the right, at least 12mm gap, not the web 920px crop. Inverse logo in an ink header bar, not on mint. One chapter per page with page-break-after always. Uses charts.py chart_svg / waffle / donut and figures.md CSS, not a generic pie.
